rows.grounds: nadīnagahradaprāyaṃ = like-rivers-mountains-and-pools (bahuvrīhi/compound adj., neuter nominative singular)
yacca = and-whatever (relative pronoun neuter + indeclinable particle; sandhi of yat + ca)
tanmṛtau = that-at-death (compound: tad + mṛti, locative singular)
utkṛṣṭaṃ = supreme (past passive participle used adjectivally, neuter nominative singular)
tanmṛtānāṃ = for-those-who-die-with-that (compound: tad + mṛta, masculine genitive plural)
svargabhogopabhogitā = enjoyment-of-heavenly-experience (compound abstract noun, feminine nominative singular)
